abstract.text: Build your own search screen that searches your publications’ editions with the SDK’s search service and opens results in your own reader screen.

inlineContent.text: The prebuilt search screen sends the user’s query when they submit it,
lists the matching articles and pages with a filter for each, and opens a
tapped result’s edition at its page. In a custom UI, you build that
screen yourself.
